chunks: And Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
That Ali عليه السلام administered the prescribed punishment to a man who married a woman during her postpartum bleeding before she became pure.

key_terms.قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْهُرَ: before she becomes pure from bleeding
key_terms.نِفَاسِهَا: her postpartum bleeding period after childbirth

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a woman before she becomes pure from postpartum bleeding?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam Ali عليه السلام concerning a man who contracted marriage with a woman while she was still in nifas. It highlights the seriousness of violating legal limits related to marriage and ritual purity in Shia fiqh.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5010 - Narrated by Hammad from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah (as):
"Indeed, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) punished with the prescribed punishment (hadd) a man who married a woman during her postpartum bleeding (nifas) before she became pure."
